a: The Late Show with Stephen Colbert
d:
If you don't know his favorite smell, or his earliest memory, do you really know Stephen Colbert? Get to know him on a deeper level with help from special guest questioners Evie McGee Colbert, Amy Sedaris and Ben Stiller, and keep watching for the thrilling conclusion of Stephen Colbert's turn at taking !
Watch The Late Show with Stephen Colbert weeknights at 11:35 PM ET/10:35 PM CT. Only on CBS.
